# Plan 0058 M1 (Spec 0058 R6, ruling Q8; J3): the atlantis.remote/1
# conformance vectors, generated by the C++ codec and the C++ Gameplay SDK and
# checked against the committed files. Needs no .NET.
add_executable(atlantis_csharp_conformance_tests
  conformance_tests.cpp
)

# The codec is Atlantis Remote's private wire library (as tests/remote uses
# it); the transcripts reuse the Gameplay SDK tests' InProcess fixture.
target_include_directories(atlantis_csharp_conformance_tests PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/remote/src
  ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/gameplay_sdk
)

target_link_libraries(atlantis_csharp_conformance_tests
  PRIVATE
    atlantis_remote_wire
    Atlantis::RemoteClient
    Atlantis::GameplaySdk
    Catch2::Catch2WithMain
    atlantis_compiler_warnings
)

target_compile_definitions(atlantis_csharp_conformance_tests PRIVATE
  ATLANTIS_CSHARP_CONFORMANCE_DIR="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}"
  ATLANTIS_CSHARP_CONFORMANCE_EXPECTED_DIR="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/csharp_conformance"
)

catch_discover_tests(atlantis_csharp_conformance_tests DISCOVERY_MODE PRE_TEST)
